articles.title: Betting the Patriots in 2026: See how New England's win total, Super Bowl odds are trending and our best bets
articles.summary: After enduring consecutive 4-13 seasons under Bill Belichick (2023) and Jerod Mayo, the New England Patriots, led by Mike Vrabel, reportedly engineered one of their most significant turnarounds. This remarkable reversal of fortune marked a substantial shift from their recent struggles, highlighting a new trajectory for the team and defying low expectations following their consistent poor records.

articles.title: India Issues Letter of Request to France for ₹3.25-Lakh-Crore Rafale Deal
articles.summary: India has formally issued a Letter of Request to France for procuring 114 Rafale fighter jets through a government-to-government deal. Estimated at ₹3.25 lakh crore, this significant acquisition will substantially boost the Indian Air Force's capabilities and strategic prowess, strengthening national security. This marks a major step in modernizing India's defence arsenal and enhancing operational readiness.

articles.title: Coinbase enables direct rupee bank transfers in India via IMPS after FIU registration
articles.summary: US crypto exchange Coinbase now offers instant rupee deposits and withdrawals in India, a significant recovery from its rocky 2022 debut. This integration enhances accessibility for Indian users, bolstering Coinbase's presence in one of the world's largest crypto markets and showcasing evolving foreign engagement in India's digital finance sector.
